Music, on your terms.

Musikero discovers music with YouTube Data API and plays it with the visible official YouTube player. YouTube may serve ads, disable embedding for a video, and does not allow hidden background playback or downloading its music here.

For uninterrupted listening to audio you already own or are licensed to use, use Import my audio. Those audio files are not sent to a server and disappear from the list when the tab reloads.
